name: Import Topology Diagram (COMPAS CEM)
description: Import a COMPAS CEM topology diagram from a JSON file.

inputParameters.name: read
inputParameters.description: Whether to read the topology diagram from the JSON file. Nothing comes out while it is False.

inputParameters.name: filepath
inputParameters.description: The full filepath to the JSON file that stores the diagram. Do not forget to add the extension .json to the filename.
